step_by_step_reasoning:
1. Identify External Actors: A user stick figure is drawn at the bottom interacting with the Control Plane via the UI and data streams, labeled as UserConsumerWeb.
2. Identify AWS Services in Control Plane: EKS (Elastic Kubernetes Service), KMS (Key Management Service), OpenSearch (drawn/labeled as Elasticsearch), Aurora, PrivateLink, TransitGateway.
3. Identify AWS Services in Data Plane: EC2 and S3.
4. Trace Connections:
   - User -> EKS (UI management) & User -> Aurora (Data processing / petabytes scale ingress).
   - EKS -> KMS (encryption key operations).
   - EKS -> Aurora (microservices metadata persistence) and EKS -> OpenSearch (search and analytics).
   - Aurora -> OpenSearch (continuous analytics pipeline on stored data).
   - EKS -> PrivateLink and EKS -> TransitGateway (routing inter-region and cross-geo control communication).
   - PrivateLink -> EC2 and TransitGateway -> S3 (connecting control plane to data plane storage/compute resources).
